headline: BLAND (PROP) jumps 18.33% on heavy volume and AGM resolution filing
market_take: Property stocks led the market with several large moves, highlighted by BLAND's 18.33% rise on 11.08x volume and a 50% intraday surge in KC. Food showed strength as MADAME and AQUA each posted over 10% gains, while CONS and CONMAT lagged with declines in TRITN and GEL. Unusual‑trading alerts were widespread, especially volume spikes in BLAND, MADAME, and VPO, and price‑gap moves in AQUA and WIN. Multiple high‑impact filings appeared across FOOD, PROP and PF&REIT, adding corporate‑action context to the price action.

sector_notes.note: BLAND surged 18.33% (vol ×11.08) and posted a volume‑spike of 8.7σ plus a 14.52% intraday move; KC rose 0.03 with a 50% volume jump. Filings include BLAND's AGM resolution and AP's debenture issuance.

MADAME climbed 10.34% (vol ×5.11) with an 8.1σ volume spike; AQUA opened with a 10.00% price gap and filed a high‑priority connected‑transaction disclosure. XBIO released several director and acquisition filings.
STPI advanced 7.69% on 6.19x volume, while TRITN dropped 33.33% intraday and PLE fell 11.11% intraday. TEAMG and TOA reported multiple director‑change filings.
SSPF rose 9.68% despite modest volume; M‑STOR fell 9.20% on 2.41x volume. WHART and FTREIT disclosed high‑impact connected‑transaction and capital‑increase filings.
VPO showed a 12.00% opening price gap, a 5.0σ volume spike and an 8.93% intraday decline; GFPT and LEE also posted significant volume spikes.
